deploybot: [DEPLOY] Starting deployment to prod-us-west · service=runtime · tag=v2.14.7 · commit=d4e8c6f · change window=23:00-23:30 UTC · initiated_by=@elena

elena: kicking off canary 3/5, watching latency and error rate :eyes:

maya: seeing a small spike in 504s on /v1/generate from canary-2, +30s tail latencies

ajay: checking infra metrics, canary nodes CPU trending up, mem ok

deploybot: [ALERT] runtime-canary-2 cpu_pct=88% sustained 2m · triggered by anomaly-detector

shawn: who has console access? can we pause the rollout and not hit prod-wide?

elena: pausing automated canary progression, leaving current canaries live for debug

maya: logs show increased tokenization gc pauses around request spikes, stack traces attached to ticket #INF-542

ajay: given the latency regression and alerts i'm +1 to revert to previous stable tag v2.14.6

elena: agreed. initiating rollback to v2.14.6 and pinning prod to avoid auto-redeploy. notifying SRE + oncall

deploybot: [ROLLBACK INITIATED] Reverting service runtime in prod-us-west · from tag=v2.14.7 to tag=v2.14.6 · requested_by=@elena · rollback_cmd=`rcctl deploy revert runtime prod --to-tag v2.14.6`

ops-bot: pinning runtime@prod -> v2.14.6 (ttl=indefinite) · reason="latency regression observed in canary" · pinned_by=@ops-bot

deploybot: rollback steps: scaling down canary bakes, applying v2.14.6, warming caches, router rebinds · estimated_time=3m

elena: running quick smoke: /health, /v1/generate 5x at p95

deploybot: [ROLLBACK COMPLETE] Revert to tag v2.14.6 successful · duration=3m12s · pinned=true · commit=a1b2c3d · deployed_by=@deploybot :white_check_mark:

maya: re-running smoke: p95 restored to baseline, no 504s observed in the last 2m

ajay: confirming infra metrics normalizing, CPU back to ~45% on runtime pools

shawn: filing a short incident note and flagging for post-release review. add a note to release notes: "reverted v2.14.7 due to latency regression in canary"

elena: thanks all — we'll hold v2.14.7 until root cause analysis, schedule another canary after GC tuning patch.

deploybot: [NOTE] Change window still reserved until 23:30 UTC but deploys to prod are pinned. Please follow up in #incidents for RCA and timelines.
